title: Joseph Forgives! 💛 Joseph and His Brothers | Bible Lesson for Kids | Sunday School
desc:
A boy was thrown into a dark, dry well by his very own brothers! 😢 Years later, those same brothers bowed down in front of him. What would he do? In this Sunday School lesson for kids, we hear the Bible story of Joseph: the coat of many colors, the dry well, seven years of plenty and seven hungry years, Governor Joseph, and the big moment when he says "I am Joseph!" and forgives his brothers. Then Lucy learns to forgive her little brother Ben when he knocks down her block tower, just like Joseph did!

📖 Memory verse: "Even as Christ forgave you, so you also must do." (Colossians 3:13)
🎯 Lesson: Forgiveness. A grudge is heavy, like a big brick. Joseph chose to let it go, and God turned the bad into good.
🙏 Great for Sunday School, Kindergarten and family devotion time.
